turns.q: Can I reroute the package to a different address?
turns.replyTail:
says:
Good question! In some cases, you can change delivery options after shipment. For example, DHL packages in Germany can be redirected to a service point through the DHL app. However, the available information doesn’t confirm whether a shipped package can be rerouted to a completely different address. You can track your order using the dispatch confirmation email or tracking number. If you need more help, I can connect you with a human.
